business_description_schema: Licensed and insured electrical contractor serving Northern Virginia, Washington DC, and Maryland. Residential and commercial work — installations, repairs, panel upgrades, and 24/7 emergency electrical service.

review_pitch: Real reviews from Northern Virginia, DC, and Maryland customers across residential and commercial jobs. 5.0-star average across 69 verified Google reviews.
brand_extended_coverage_phrase: We cover Northern Virginia (Fairfax County and the 50-mile radius around it including Sterling, Ashburn, Chantilly, Loudoun, and Waldorf), Washington DC, and Maryland.
owner_bio_paragraphs: Mohammed is a Master Electrician licensed in Virginia, with over 16 years in the trade. The Master tier is the highest electrician license the state issues — it requires several years of journeyman work, a passed state exam, and a clean record. Over those 16+ years Mohammed has built a residential and commercial electrical practice serving Northern Virginia, Washington DC, Maryland, and Pennsylvania. He's fully insured and runs a maintenance team, so when you call S&H Contracting Unlimited you're not waiting on one person's calendar.

Mohammed leads the work across the full electrical spectrum — panel replacements and heavy-ups, full installations, troubleshooting, emergency repairs, EV charger installation, and specialized work like home security and generator installation. He's the diagnostician on most residential calls — the one who reads the panel, runs the tests, and explains what's happening in plain English before any work starts. His preference is to find the root cause and fix it once, rather than patch the symptom and come back next month.
final_cta_response_promise: We respond within one business day.
